Chapter 262/0259: Childhood Sweethearts Often Lose to the Unexpected Newcomer

"We're almost there."

"This is a pretty good area. The property prices here must be high."

"I'm renting. There's no way I could afford to buy."

"If a big star like you can't afford it, what are ordinary people supposed to do?"

"I've only played supporting roles these past few years, so I don't get paid that much. Property prices in the capital are rising faster than my salary. Sigh, I've been typecast into the pretty vase role."

"Why not pick a different kind of role to transform your image?"

"I'm lucky to get any work at all. I'm in no position to be picky about scripts."

Yan Danchen was quite talkative, chatting with Chen Guiliang the whole way back.

Even among stars, her looks were quite striking.

CEO Chen, who had always been a man of virtue, couldn't help but let his imagination wander.

Yan Danchen raised her wrist to check her watch. "It's still early. Why don't we find a place for coffee? There's one right nearby."

Coffee was fine.

If she had invited him directly to her home, Chen Guiliang wouldn't have dared to agree. A girl who was too forward on the first meeting... he was genuinely afraid of trouble. It would be bad to get scammed.

Brother Dong's cautionary tale was still fresh in his mind.

"Alright," Chen Guiliang casually replied.

Yan Danchen said to Yang Shuo, "Driver, please pull over here."

The temperature was over thirty degrees Celsius. With no air conditioning outside, Yan Danchen took off her lavish coat.

Underneath was a low-cut top, which drew a lot of attention on the street.

There were no high-end coffee shops nearby, only an SPR Coffee and a Wenhuiyuan Book Cafe. Students from Beijing Normal University and Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications often came here.

Yan Danchen seemed to be a regular at this cafe and was on familiar terms with the staff. "One mocha, please. What would you like, CEO Chen?"

"Americano," Chen Guiliang said.

Chen Guiliang scanned the surroundings and found it quite nice.

Many customers were holding books, sitting and drinking alone in various spots.

Yan Danchen said, "They sell both coffee and books here, and you can read for free if you order a coffee. The coffee isn't expensive either, 15 to 25 yuan a cup. I used to have a high school classmate who went to BNU. After she graduated, she rented a place here and roped me into sharing it with her. But now she's gone abroad, leaving me to cover the rent all by myself."

"Haha, you should act in more dramas and buy a flat. If you buy now, it'll definitely appreciate," Chen Guiliang said with a laugh.

Yan Danchen said very reservedly, "I'm rather conservative. There are certain things I'm unwilling to do, so leading roles always seem to pass me by."

Chen Guiliang said, "I know two directors. One is Ning Hao, the other is Shang Jing. If they need an actress one day, I can help recommend you. I can't guarantee anything, though."

Yan Danchen sounded a bit excited. "Those two directors are really popular right now. *My Own Swordsman* and *Crazy Stone* both got excellent reviews."

Just as Chen Guiliang was about to speak, he saw two familiar people walk in.

Xu Fengyin and Ding Beili.

They were being led into the coffee shop by a man.

Xu Fengyin had a look of resignation on her face, as if she really didn't want to be there.

Ding Beili, however, was neither happy nor sad, instead looking around the cafe with curiosity.

"There's an empty table over there!" the man said with great attentiveness.

Chen Guiliang watched them walk past a short distance away.

Yan Danchen asked, "Your friends?"

"Yeah," Chen Guiliang nodded.

Yan Danchen watched them for a moment with curiosity, then began to play Sherlock Holmes. "That man is being very attentive and considerate to both girls, bustling about to move their chairs and hand them menus. But his main target is the one with the large chest. The smaller-chested girl is actually the third wheel."

"Such a sharp eye?" Chen Guiliang chuckled.

Yan Danchen said, "Look, his attention is always on the busty girl. She's clearly a little impatient but doesn't know how to refuse. The smaller-chested girl isn't saying much. She seems more interested in the coffee shop, constantly looking around... I think she saw you."

Ding Beili was indeed looking all over the place. When she suddenly saw Chen Guiliang, she was startled. But then she pretended not to know him and quickly looked away.

Who wants to see their boss on a weekend?

I don't know you!

The man was a few years older than Xu Fengyin, the "big brother" from next door. Their fathers even worked at the same company.

Ignoring the age gap, they could loosely be considered childhood friends.

A childhood friendship like this rarely develops into a romance.

The man's name was Shen Yifan, and he could be called young and successful. After getting his master's degree from Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications, he went straight to the Lenovo Research Institute next to the campus and was currently involved in the ThinkPad integration project.

Moreover, his family had pooled all their savings to help him with the down payment for a flat in the Wenhuiyuan residential complex before Beijing's property prices skyrocketed.

A Beijing hukou, and a house!

"The property prices here are rising incredibly fast," Shen Yifan said. "When I bought, it was only four thousand per square meter, now it's up to seven or eight thousand. If I hadn't bought it, it would have gone up even more next year. If you buy a flat here, your kids can attend the BNU Experimental Primary School in the future. They can also get directly into the junior high division of the Second Affiliated Middle School of BNU."

Xu Fengyin was speechless. "I'm just looking at flats. I haven't even decided whether to buy or not. What are you talking about kids and school for?"

Shen Yifan said with a serious expression, "Buying a house is a major life event, and so is your children's education. Of course, you have to consider two major events thoroughly. Uncle and Auntie asked me to help you out, so I have to be responsible for you. I can't let you just buy any random place."

"This is too far from my company," Xu Fengyin said.

Shen Yifan said, "It's not far, the commute is very convenient. You can take the subway to Wudaokou, then transfer to a bus. It won't take long."

Xu Fengyin said, "I still want to look at other residential areas."

Shen Yifan said, "Then I'll go with you to look at flats again next weekend. It's easy for a girl like you to be taken advantage of when looking alone. You might get ripped off by the real estate agent."

"Let's see," Xu Fengyin politely declined.

She had only casually mentioned that she wanted to buy a house while on the phone with her family. The very next day, her parents called back, saying they had contacted Brother Shen from next door, and he had agreed to go with her to look at properties.

Xu Fengyin didn't think much of it. When she was about to graduate from primary school, Shen Yifan was already in high school.

What kind of special feelings could there be?

She had only liked to follow him around when she was still wearing split-crotch pants. And Shen Yifan had been reluctant back then, finding it annoying to have a little kid trailing him.

Who knew that when they met again this time, Xu Fengyin would find something amiss.

The neighborhood big brother she hadn't seen in years was being a bit too enthusiastic toward her. Xu Fengyin wasn't an idiot; how could she not guess what he was thinking?

She was too familiar with Brother Shen. It would be very awkward if they started dating.

Besides, she had a thing for looks.

And Shen Yifan's appearance could only be described as not-unattractive.

Shen Yifan continued to talk about housing. "Yicheng Dongyuan over there is also nice. The landscaping is good, and there are many different apartment layouts. I considered it when I was buying my place. Next door are the Forestry University and the Language and Culture University, and the price is a little higher than Wenhuiyuan."

This kid was too earnest, a bit of a one-track mind.

Having promised Xu Fengyin's parents, he believed he had to see the task through.

At the same time, he had his own ulterior motives. He was trying to persuade Xu Fengyin to buy a flat in this area so they would be neighbors. Being in a favorable position, he might just be able to win her over.

Shen Yifan hadn't seen Xu Fengyin in many years. The little neighborhood kid from his memory had now blossomed into a stunning beauty.

Yan Danchen was still chatting, "How did you meet Director Ning?"

Chen Guiliang smiled. "I was sightseeing at night in the Mountain City and ran into Ning Hao filming *Crazy Stone*. My classmates and I even got to be extras for a second or two."

Yan Danchen thought to herself: Only because you're a big boss. Otherwise, who gets to be an extra just by asking?

Chen Guiliang asked, "By the way, how come you're on *Behind the Headlines* so often?"

"I can't get any acting roles, so I'm bored," Yan Danchen said, amused. "When *Lotus Lantern* was popular, *Behind the Headlines* was starting to shift its focus to the mainland and wanted to have the stars from the cast on for an episode. Haha, they invited the big shots from the crew, but they all said they were too busy. I was the only one who agreed. I recorded one episode and thought it was pretty fun. Dou Wentao also felt I was good at conversation, so he'd call me whenever he couldn't find a guest."

"You really are a good conversationalist." Chen Guiliang noticed that she had a bit of an artistic temperament, yet was blessed with the face of a pretty vase, which made her positioning as an actress somewhat awkward.

Over at the other table, Ding Beili was bored and went to grab a book.

Xu Fengyin took the opportunity to change the subject. "What book is that?"

Ding Beili said, "I don't know, I just grabbed one randomly. Let me see the title... It's called *Brothers*. It might be about gangsters."

Xu Fengyin glanced over. "What gangsters? This is Yu Hua's new book."

"Who's Yu Hua?" Ding Beili asked with a look of pure innocence.

Xu Fengyin said, "A writer. Our boss even knows him."

"Oh, so they all know each other," Ding Beili said. Seeing that Xu Fengyin didn't want to chat nonsense with this neighborhood brother anymore, she pointed toward Chen Guiliang and said, "I just saw the boss. He's having coffee with a beautiful woman."

"Where?" Xu Fengyin asked.

Ding Beili said, "With his side to us. That woman looks a little familiar. Doesn't she look like Chang'e from *Lotus Lantern*?"

Xu Fengyin immediately had an excuse to escape. "Brother Shen, I'm going over to say hi to my boss."

Shen Yifan was pleasantly surprised. "Chen Guiliang? I know him. I work in hardware, and he's in social networking."

With that, this guy stood up even before Xu Fengyin and walked over to Chen Guiliang. "CEO Chen, hello. My name is Shen Yifan, an engineer from the Lenovo Research Institute."

"Hello." Chen Guiliang smiled and shook his hand.

Shen Yifan said, "Xu Fengyin is my younger sister. Thank you for looking after her, CEO Chen."

Chen Guiliang said, "Not at all, not at all. It's Xu Fengyin who has outstanding work ability. The things she draws always sell very well."

Perhaps to boost his own image, Shen Yifan took the initiative to talk about work. "Lenovo acquired IBM's personal computer business last year, right? With the two giants merging, the hardware technology needs to be integrated. I'm currently involved in the ThinkPad integration project."

Chen Guiliang said, "My respects. I didn't realize you were a tech guru."

"I wouldn't say guru, I just do what I can on the team," Shen Yifan said. "I certainly can't compare to you, CEO Chen, starting your own company before you even graduated. My sister here has been introverted since she was little and gets bullied easily. Please take good care of her in the future, CEO Chen."

Chen Guiliang said, "A boss will certainly take care of his employees, especially an outstanding one."

Xu Fengyin asked, "Boss, when are you heading back? I'd like to catch a ride."

Catch a ride my foot. Can't you see I'm having coffee with a female celebrity?

Yan Danchen smiled. "It's about time. Let's talk again some other day. I won't disturb you all."

"Alright then, we'll talk another day," Chen Guiliang said.

Yan Danchen said goodbye to the others and got up to leave.

Given her personality, she had already been exceptionally forward today. It was mainly because Chen Guiliang was young, rich, and handsome. That's why she was willing to risk Dou Wentao's teasing to get more contact with him.

But she was too embarrassed to actually let Chen Guiliang take her home, so she had chosen a coffee shop to sit for a while.

Chen Guiliang also stood up. "Let's go. I'll take you two back."

The neighbor, Brother Shen, quickly followed them out to wait for the car by the roadside.

Chen Guiliang called Yang Shuo to bring the car around. As everyone was getting in, Shen Yifan was still saying, "Next weekend, I'll go with you to see other residential areas."

Xu Fengyin politely refused, "I'm not set on buying, and I have to work overtime next weekend."

"Then the weekend after that," Shen Yifan said. "Whenever you have time, I'll take leave to go with you even if I have to work overtime at my company."

"We'll see," Xu Fengyin still didn't agree.

After getting in the car, Chen Guiliang sat in the front passenger seat, and the two girls sat in the back.

Chen Guiliang inquired, "He doesn't seem like your cousin."

Xu Fengyin said, "He's the brother from next door. He was already taking the college entrance exams when I was in my first year of middle school." The girl abruptly changed the subject. "CEO Chen, you're not being honest, having coffee with a beautiful woman behind your girlfriend's back!"

"I just finished recording a show and we were having a casual chat," Chen Guiliang felt inexplicably guilty and didn't dare scold her for being nosy. He instead resorted to bribery. "Why don't you just buy a place in the same complex as Dong Qianqiu and the others? The location is good, there's great potential for appreciation, and it's close to the company. If you don't have enough for the down payment, I can lend you the money."

Xu Fengyin asked, "Lend me money to buy a house? You're not thinking of..."

Chen Guiliang didn't know whether to laugh or cry. "What are you thinking? You're an outstanding employee of the company. I have to offer some benefits to lock you in and prevent you from being poached by another company."

Ding Beili thought to herself: Are outstanding employees this sought after? I want to borrow money to buy a house too.

(End of Chapter)
